## Summary

Adel Lajil is a senior software engineer in Québec who builds SaaS platforms and industrial IoT cloud systems with .NET, Angular, and Azure. He is a backend-first full-stack engineer with 6+ years of experience building SaaS products, public-sector applications, and device-cloud systems. He likes owning the full path: understand the workflow, write the architecture decision record, build the change, review it with the team, and stay close when it reaches production.

Proof points: 6+ years building software, 5,000+ devices provisioned, 7 developers led, 30%+ Azure cost reduction, 100+ organizations served.

## Current role

**Senior Cloud Full-Stack Developer at Evident Industrial** (Jul 2024 – Present), Québec, Canada, Hybrid.

He builds and supports cloud software that connects industrial devices to EvidentConnect, a multi-tenant SaaS platform used by more than 100 organizations.

- Works across three AKS microservices and owns several device services, Azure Functions, and operational workflows.
- Maintains provisioning for 5,000+ devices through IoT Hub, Device Provisioning Service (DPS), X.509 certificates, and custom allocation policies.
- Writes architecture decision records (ADRs), reviews pull requests, presents technical options, debugs production issues, and mentors an intern.

Stack: .NET 8-10, Angular 18-21, AKS, Azure IoT, gRPC, Terraform.

## Career history

**Full-Stack .NET Developer / Analyst Programmer — Cofomo / Revenu Québec** (Nov 2022 – Jun 2024), Québec, Canada.
Delivered application and infrastructure changes for large public-sector systems using ASP.NET Core, Angular, Dapper, and Azure DevOps. Reviewed changes, joined story analysis and estimation, and supported system, integration, and user-acceptance testing.

**R&D Development Team Lead — Podyam** (Dec 2020 – Aug 2022), Tunisia.
Led a seven-developer team working on Podium360, a multi-tenant sustainable-finance platform. Built reporting, scheduled jobs, document workflows, and a Python portfolio-optimization API. Cut Azure infrastructure costs by more than 30% through right-sizing and Cosmos DB changes.

**Freelance Backend Developer — SnB: Sell & Buy** (earlier, remote).
Built backend services for a geo-proximity marketplace with 100K+ downloads and 50K+ monthly transactions: location-based search, push notifications, Google Maps integration, Redis caching, and container deployment.

## Selected projects

**CleanTrack** (independent product, 2026) — Separate portals for cleaning managers, workers, and clients: scheduling, mobile checklists, proof-of-work photos, and service approvals. Stack: .NET 10, Angular 19, PostgreSQL, SignalR, Docker. Live: https://cleantrack.adellajil.com/

**Slotafy** (independent product, 2026) — A restaurant SaaS with QR ordering, kitchen displays, live order updates, Stripe billing, and GitOps deployments. Stack: .NET 10, Angular 21, PostgreSQL, Stripe, Kubernetes. Live: https://slotafy.com/

**Homelab Infrastructure** (personal infrastructure) — Proxmox infrastructure across two hosts, managed with Pulumi and Ansible, with application and monitoring stacks deployed through Komodo (Grafana, Loki).

**SnB: Sell & Buy** (freelance backend work, 2021) — A location-based marketplace backend with Google Maps integration, push notifications, Redis caching, and container deployment. 100K+ downloads and 50K+ monthly transactions. Live: https://www.snbapp.com/

**Spur** (open source) — A .NET `Result<T>` library for explicit error handling, fluent pipelines, and ASP.NET Core integration. Source: https://github.com/AdelSS04/Spur · Docs: https://spur.adellajil.com/

**Podium360** (enterprise, team lead role at Podyam, 2020) — Sustainable-finance product: reporting, document workflows, portfolio optimization, and Azure cost reduction of more than 30%. Stack: .NET 5, Angular, Cosmos DB, RabbitMQ. Live: https://www.podyam.com/

**Cosmigrator** (open source) — A framework for versioned Cosmos DB migrations, with bulk operations, retries, and a CLI for deployment pipelines. Source: https://github.com/AdelSS04/Cosmigrator

**Clean DDD Architecture** (open source, 2021) — A .NET reference project demonstrating Domain-Driven Design, repositories, and separation between application logic and infrastructure. Source: https://github.com/AdelSS04/CleanDDDArchitecture

**Terraform Azure Fullstack Starter** (open source, 2025) — A Terraform starter for Azure applications with separate environments, Auth0 authentication, and GitLab CI/CD configuration. Source: https://github.com/AdelSS04/terraform-azure-fullstack-starter

## Freelance services (Québec small businesses)

Adel Lajil builds custom websites and tools for small businesses in Québec, in French or English, with a single point of contact:

- Professional websites: creation or redesign, mobile-first, SEO-friendly.
- Custom internal tools: dashboards, automation, role-based access.
- Web applications: client portals, online booking, ordering, or inventory management, built in .NET and Angular.
- Cloud & infrastructure: hosting, security, and backups on Azure.

Process: discovery call, clear written proposal (scope, timeline, price), delivery in visible steps, and follow-up support after go-live.
